llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究CuZr基金属玻璃复合材料的选区激光熔化，未涉及生物医学应用或应力遮挡问题。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address biomedical implants, stress shielding, stiffness matching, fatigue testing, or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 通过SLM制备CuZr基金属玻璃复合材料
summary_zh.result: 成功制备出金属玻璃复合材料

summary_en.motivation: To fabricate CuZr-based metallic glass composites using selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Selective laser melting (SLM) was employed to process the composite materials.
summary_en.result: The SLM process successfully produced dense metallic glass composites with good mechanical properties.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing and microstructural characterization were performed to validate the material properties.

papers.title: Effect of Heat Treatment on Microstructure and Properties of FGH4096M Superalloy Processed by Selective Laser Melting
papers.first_author_affiliation: School of Materials Science and Engineering, University of Science and Technology Beijing (USTB), Beijing, 100083, China

corresponding_authors.name: Xinggang Li
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Academy for Advanced Interdisciplinary Studies, Southern University of Science and Technology (SUSTech), Shenzhen, 518055, China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究的是航空航天用高温合金的热处理工艺，与生物医用植入物的多孔结构、应力遮挡、疲劳性能等无任何关联。
llm.why_not_core: No biomedical implant context, no porous structure, no stress shielding analysis, no fatigue or osseointegration evaluation.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究热处理对SLM成型高温合金微观结构和力学性能的影响
summary_zh.method: 对FGH4096M合金进行SLM制备及不同热处理
summary_zh.result: 热处理显著改变了显微组织和力学性能
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸测试和微观表征验证

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of heat treatment on microstructure and mechanical properties of a superalloy processed by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: FGH4096M superalloy samples were fabricated by SLM and subjected to various heat treatment regimes.
summary_en.result: Heat treatment significantly altered the microstructure and improved mechanical properties.
